# Setting a new standard for the future of pharma

  SLX-100

  to a Defective Delivery System

  Alvogen Completes Sale to Lotus, Creating a Leading International Specialized Generics Platform
  ][41]

Alvogen

## America's pharmaceutical future

**America's pharmaceutical future is strengthened in Norwich, New York.** For over 130 years,
Norwich has been a bedrock of American pharmaceutical manufacturing. Today, Alvogen continues this
proud tradition by producing high-quality generic medications that make healthcare more affordable
and accessible for millions of Americans.

[America's pharmaceutical future][42]
Company

## Who we are

Alvogen is a US-based company focused on developing, in-licensing, manufacturing and marketing
pharmaceutical products.

Alvogen's companies include:

Alvogen generic business
Almatica brand products
Almaject injectables
Norwich US-based manufacturing

[About us][43]
Products

## Targeted portfolio

Alvogen is growing its portfolio of complex, high value products including complex inhalation,
injectables and strategic 505(b)(2) products.

Alvogen has over 50 products currently on market and extensive R&D capabilities fueling its growing
pipeline.

[Our Products][44]
Purpose

## Making a difference

Our true purpose as a company is to make people's lives better by producing high quality medicines
that help people live longer, healthier and more active lives and making them more accessible to
those who might not otherwise be able to afford them.

[Our purpose][45]
Partnerships

## Open for collaboration

At Alvogen, we value partnerships and collaboration. Our future strategy relies heavily on our
strategic selection of people and successful partnerships around the world.

[Partnerships][46]
Offices

## Offices

Alvogen has offices in New Jersey and manufacturing plant in Norwich, New York.

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]

manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work.

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,

our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Event Participation

* **Arab Health**
* **IPHEX**
* **CPHI India**
Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

### BUILD OR ENHANCE YOUR CURRENT SUPPLY WITH AKUMS

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

## Bowel cancer

Bowel cancer, also known as colorectal cancer, can affect any part of the colon or rectum.

It may also be referred to as colon cancer or rectal cancer depending on where the cancer is
located.

The colon and rectum are parts of the large intestine.

[What is bowel cancer?][123]
[ [An anatomical illustration of a human torso with the intestines highlighted in red and a tumor
indicated.][An anatomical illustration of a human torso with the intestines highlighted in red and a
tumor indicated.] ][124]

## Screening

Bowel cancer screening is for people who do not already have bowel cancer, [symptoms][125] of bowel
cancer, or any reason to have a [high risk][126] of bowel cancer.

Medical guidelines state the recommended strategy for population screening in Australia, directed at
those at average risk of bowel cancer and without relevant symptoms, is faecal immunochemical
testing every 2 years, starting at age 45 years and continuing to age 74 years.

[Screening options][127]
[ [A display box for ColoVantage home bowel screening tests with cheerful images of people and
informational text.][A display box for ColoVantage home bowel screening tests with cheerful images
of people and informational text.] ][128]
[Blurred image of a hospital waiting area with people seated and a reception desk in the
foreground.][Blurred image of a hospital waiting area with people seated and a reception desk in the
foreground.]


### Bowel cancer is the fourth most common type of newly diagnosed cancer and second deadliest in
### Australia.

[Map of Australia with the text ][Map of Australia with the text ]
14904
Australians are told they have bowel cancer each year
5372
lives lost to bowel cancer each year
99 %
of cases can be treated successfully when detected in the earliest stage
163000
Australians living with or beyond bowel cancer.

## We’re here for you

Bowel Cancer Australia’s essential support services are uniquely designed for you, whether living
with or beyond bowel cancer, providing an extra layer of support to the trusted relationship you
have with your treating medical team.

[ [Five women in green polo shirts smiling together, with the text "We're here for you" above
them.][Five women in green polo shirts smiling together, with the text "We're here for you" above
them.] ][129]
Specialist support

Our essential support services uniquely designed for bowel cancer patients via our confidential
Helpline with specialist telehealth support.

[Learn More][130]
[ [Three people sit at a table in a bright café, engaged in conversation and smiling, with coffee
cups nearby.][Three people sit at a table in a bright café, engaged in conversation and smiling,
with coffee cups nearby.] ][131]
Peer-to-peer network

Australia’s only national support group for bowel cancer patients – newly diagnosed, living with or
beyond bowel cancer.

[Learn More][132]
[ [A collage of diverse individuals smiling, engaging in various activities, and posing in different
settings.][A collage of diverse individuals smiling, engaging in various activities, and posing in
different settings.] ][133]
The Movement

Our nurse moderated Facebook Group, with monthly expert guests, is a place to connect with other
patients and share lived experiences.

[Learn More][134]
[ [Black athletic shoes and a dumbbell on a wooden floor, with text promoting wellness and Bowel
Cancer Australia.][Black athletic shoes and a dumbbell on a wooden floor, with text promoting
wellness and Bowel Cancer Australia.] ][135]
Meaningful Movement

Our closed personal trainer guided Facebook Group to assist patients seeking to prioritise exercise
alongside treatment.

[Learn More][136]
[ [A close-up of a woman smiling near a microphone and laptop in a casual workspace.][A close-up of
a woman smiling near a microphone and laptop in a casual workspace.] ][137]
BottomLine Podcast

Our monthly podcast sharing stories, lived experiences and health professional knowledge about bowel
cancer treatment and care.

[Learn More][138]
[ [A collection of informational brochures about bowel cancer, featuring various images and titles
related to support and treatment.][A collection of informational brochures about bowel cancer,
featuring various images and titles related to support and treatment.] ][139]
Free patient resources

Covering all aspects of bowel cancer: prevention, early detection, diagnosis, surgery, treatment,
and adjusting to the ‘new’ normal.

[Learn More][140]
[ [Four people are seated around a table, smiling and engaged in conversation, with laptops and
drinks present.][Four people are seated around a table, smiling and engaged in conversation, with
laptops and drinks present.] ][141]
Lived-experiences

A valuable resource if you find it helpful to read stories of others who are living with or have
been affected by bowel cancer.

[Learn More][142]
[ [A group of people in red shirts stands in front of a building, raising their arms in support of
bowel cancer awareness.][A group of people in red shirts stands in front of a building, raising
their arms in support of bowel cancer awareness.] ][143]
Call on Canberra

Our Never2Young Advocacy Agenda seeks to improve care experiences and health outcomes for younger
people.

[Learn More][144]

## Bowel cancer

Bowel cancer, also known as colorectal cancer, can affect any part of the colon or rectum.

It may also be referred to as colon cancer or rectal cancer depending on where the cancer is
located.

The colon and rectum are parts of the large intestine.

[What is bowel cancer?][123]
[ [An anatomical illustration of a human torso with the intestines highlighted in red and a tumor
indicated.][An anatomical illustration of a human torso with the intestines highlighted in red and a
tumor indicated.] ][124]

## Screening

Bowel cancer screening is for people who do not already have bowel cancer, [symptoms][125] of bowel
cancer, or any reason to have a [high risk][126] of bowel cancer.

Medical guidelines state the recommended strategy for population screening in Australia, directed at
those at average risk of bowel cancer and without relevant symptoms, is faecal immunochemical
testing every 2 years, starting at age 45 years and continuing to age 74 years.

[Screening options][127]
[ [A display box for ColoVantage home bowel screening tests with cheerful images of people and
informational text.][A display box for ColoVantage home bowel screening tests with cheerful images
of people and informational text.] ][128]
[Blurred image of a hospital waiting area with people seated and a reception desk in the
foreground.][Blurred image of a hospital waiting area with people seated and a reception desk in the
foreground.]

with or beyond bowel cancer, providing an extra layer of support to the trusted relationship you
have with your treating medical team.

### CARBOGEN AMCIS Commissions Ground-Mounted Pho-tovoltaic Plant at Its Hunzenschwil Site

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

## Reliable development
## Reliable distribution
## Reliable innovation
## Reliable through 5 generations

## CONTACT

Reach out to our industry experts to discuss
how we can work together to grow your business.

Please see Important Safety Information and full Prescribing Information

## Indication

CLENPIQ^{®} is a prescription medicine used by adults and children 9 years and older to clean the
colon before a colonoscopy. CLENPIQ cleans your colon by causing you to have diarrhea. Cleaning your
colon helps your healthcare provider see the inside of your colon more clearly during your
colonoscopy.

## Important Safety Information
* Do not take CLENPIQ if your healthcare provider has told you that you have serious kidney
  problems, a blockage in your intestine (bowel obstruction), an opening in the wall of your stomach
  or intestines (bowel perforation), a very dilated intestine (toxic megacolon), problems with the
  emptying of food and fluid from your stomach (gastric retention), or an allergy to any of the
  ingredients in CLENPIQ.
* CLENPIQ and other bowel preparations can cause serious side effects, including serious loss of
  body fluid (dehydration) and changes in blood salts (electrolytes) in your blood. These changes
  can cause abnormal heartbeats that may result in death, seizures (this can happen even if you have
  never had a seizure), or kidney problems. Your chance of having fluid loss and changes in blood
  salts with CLENPIQ is higher if you have heart problems, have kidney problems, or take water pills
  or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDS).
* Your healthcare provider may do blood tests after you take CLENPIQ to check your blood for
  changes. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you have any of these symptoms resulting from
  a loss of too much body fluid (dehydration): vomiting, nausea, bloating, dizziness, stomach-area
  (abdominal) cramping, urinating less often than normal, trouble drinking clear liquids, troubles
  swallowing, seizures, or heart problems.
* Tell your healthcare provider if you have a history of fainting. Fainting may occur resulting in a
  fall requiring hospitalization. Adequately hydrate with a variety of clear liquids including
  balanced electrolyte solutions such as sports drinks. When getting up from a lying or sitting
  position, get up gradually.
* CLENPIQ can cause ulcers of the bowel or bowel problems (ischemic colitis). Tell your healthcare
  provider right away if you have severe stomach-area (abdominal) pain or rectal bleeding.
* The most common side effects of CLENPIQ in adults include nausea, headache, high magnesium levels
  in your blood, dehydration or dizziness and stomach area (abdominal) pain. The most common side
  effects of CLENPIQ in children 9 to 16 years of age include nausea, vomiting and stomach area
  (abdominal) pain. These are not all the possible side effects of CLENPIQ. Ask your doctor or
  pharmacist for more information.

You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs to the FDA. Visit
[www.fda.gov/medwatch][1], or call 1-800-FDA-1088. Please see accompanying [full Prescribing
Information][2], including Medication Guide.

## Gastroenterology Near Me: Find Expert GI Care & Relief at Manhattan Gastroenterology

Are you struggling with changes in bowel habits, prolonged abdominal pain and bloating, rectal
bleeding, or just seeking a preventative GI screening? Choose a board-certified team of
gastroenterologists dedicated to excellence in diagnosing and treating all gastrointestinal
pathologies, including acid reflux, colon cancer, and other stomach and liver disorders.

### How To Find a Gastrointestinal Doctors Near You

**Consider using the following guidelines for finding a medical professional in your area:**
* Ask your friends or relatives for recommendations.
* Search online using phrases like "**gastrointestinal doctor near me**," "**GI specialist near
  me**," or "**gastrologist near me**."
* Check online reviews of nearby GI docs.
* Discuss your treatment options with a couple of specialists by scheduling an appointment.

Dedicated to delivering the highest quality medical care within a welcoming, professional, and
personalized environment, the award-winning team of gastroenterology specialists at Manhattan
Gastroenterology employs cutting-edge medical technology, high-definition equipment, and advanced
imaging techniques in the pharmacological, immunological, and targeted treatment of Gastrointestinal
Disorders.

Our philosophy revolves around tailoring effective treatment plans that align with each patient's
unique disease progression and symptomatology, utilizing a holistic approach that addresses the
patient as a whole, following a biopsychosocial model. Our services encompass screenings for colon
cancer and various conditions affecting the colon, small intestine, and upper gastrointestinal
tract. We are dedicated to assisting patients in receiving preventive care, mitigating the risk of
serious issues, and promoting overall health and well-being.

## Procedures

The most frequent reasons that patients from throughout NYC visit ***New York Gastroenterology***
Centers.

### [Hemorrhoids][119]

Hemorrhoids are veins around the anus or lower rectum that have become swollen and inflamed.
Hemorrhoids are prevalent in men and women. Our hemorrhoid specialists offer the latest hemorrhoid
treatments to get you back on track.

### [Laser Hemorrhoid Removal][120]

Our doctors offer various newest options to treat hemorrhoids, including laser hemorrhoid removal
and hemorrhoidal banding as well as infrared coagulation (or IRC), which is effective and fast
acting.

### [Colonoscopy][121]

Colonoscopy is considered the gold standard of colon cancer screening methods. It allows our GI
specialist to examine a large intestine. Colonoscopy is also effectively used to evaluate symptoms,
including rectal bleeding, chronic diarrhea, and chronic constipation.

### [Breath Testing][122]

A breath test diagnoses conditions such as fructose, lactose intolerance, and SIBO. These disorders
create a chemical response that can be measured in your breath.

### [Upper Endoscopy][123]

Upper endoscopy is a procedure to examine a person’s upper digestive tract. Using high-definition
endoscopes, we can visualize the esophagus, stomach, and upper part of the small intestine to make
an accurate diagnosis.

### [High Resolution Anoscopy (HRA)][124]

High-Resolution Anoscopy (HRA) diagnostic test helps evaluate various anal conditions, such as anal
dysplasia (abnormal growth of cells in the anal canal) and anal cancer. Patients at higher risk for
anal cancer should have an anal pap smear performed.

[View all procedures][125]

conditions such as abdominal pain, peptic ulcers, diarrhea, Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis,

## Gastroenterology Near Me: Find Expert GI Care & Relief at Manhattan Gastroenterology

Are you struggling with changes in bowel habits, prolonged abdominal pain and bloating, rectal
bleeding, or just seeking a preventative GI screening? Choose a board-certified team of
gastroenterologists dedicated to excellence in diagnosing and treating all gastrointestinal
pathologies, including acid reflux, colon cancer, and other stomach and liver disorders.

### How To Find a Gastrointestinal Doctors Near You

**Consider using the following guidelines for finding a medical professional in your area:**
* Ask your friends or relatives for recommendations.
* Search online using phrases like "**gastrointestinal doctor near me**," "**GI specialist near
  me**," or "**gastrologist near me**."
* Check online reviews of nearby GI docs.
* Discuss your treatment options with a couple of specialists by scheduling an appointment.

Dedicated to delivering the highest quality medical care within a welcoming, professional, and
personalized environment, the award-winning team of gastroenterology specialists at Manhattan
Gastroenterology employs cutting-edge medical technology, high-definition equipment, and advanced
imaging techniques in the pharmacological, immunological, and targeted treatment of Gastrointestinal
Disorders.

Our philosophy revolves around tailoring effective treatment plans that align with each patient's
unique disease progression and symptomatology, utilizing a holistic approach that addresses the
patient as a whole, following a biopsychosocial model. Our services encompass screenings for colon
cancer and various conditions affecting the colon, small intestine, and upper gastrointestinal
tract. We are dedicated to assisting patients in receiving preventive care, mitigating the risk of
serious issues, and promoting overall health and well-being.

Great staff, great care, great part of a health care movement that cuts through the insurance and

## We will end colorectal cancer, together

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is fiercely determined to end colon and rectal cancers within our
lifetime. Together with a nation of passionate allies, we advocate for prevention, magnify support,
and accelerate research to stop this disease. Your contribution helps bring us closer to a world
free from colorectal cancer.

[Donate Now][147]
[The things you hear Vicki]Play

## Your colorectal cancer ally

Find resources for patients, survivors, caregivers, and family members.

[Seth Tabor man in hospital providing thumbs up]

### Colorectal cancer basics

Colorectal cancer is a cancer that starts in the colon or rectum, which are parts of the digestive
system. Unlike most cancers, colorectal cancer is often preventable with screening and highly
treatable when detected early.

[What is colorectal cancer?][148]
[Three people with poop emoji at an event]

### Screening and prevention

The best way to prevent colorectal cancer is getting screened on time. Screenings can also find
cancer early when treatment is most effective. Most people should begin colorectal cancer screenings
at age 45, but people with certain risk factors may need to start screening earlier.

[Take the screening quiz][149]
[Woman ringing cancer bell at hospital]

### Treating colorectal cancer

Colorectal cancer is highly treatable if caught early. There are many types of treatments for
colorectal cancer, including surgery, chemo, radiation, and other therapies. Your treatment
typically depends on the location of the cancer and the stage of diagnosis.

[Newly diagnosed? Start here][150]
[Volunteers at event]

### Get help and support

A colorectal cancer diagnosis can be a challenging time. It helps to know that resources, support,
and information are always available. A nation of allies is standing by ready to help you navigate
your path to survivorship.

[Access resources][151]

## Updates

[The Project Cure CRC and KLEOS adaptive clinical trial platform logos over a white and blue
gradient background.]

### [Alliance and GCAR Announce Collaboration to Advance a Groundbreaking Adaptive Clinical Trial
### Platform for CRC: KLEOS][152]

A first-of-its-kind trial platform in the colorectal cancer space, Project Cure CRC’s KLEOS is being
driven by the Colorectal Cancer Alliance, the leading nonprofit dedicated to ending the disease, in
collaboration with GCAR, a pioneer in the design and implementation of innovative clinical trials.

Last updated May 29, 2026
[The Alliance and Screen Smart logos. ]

### [Alliance Breaks Down New ACS Screening Guidelines][153]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is urging Americans to prioritize colorectal cancer screening, as the
American Cancer Society (ACS) released updated guidelines today.

Last updated May 27, 2026
[An image announcing that the Alliance has won a Webby award for LEAD FROM BEHIND]

### [LEAD FROM BEHIND Honored with Prestigious Webby Award][154]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance LEAD FROM BEHIND initiative featuring Katie Couric is a winner in the
30th Annual Webby Awards.

Last updated Apr 21, 2026

## I was diagnosed with stage-I colon cancer. Due to my cancer’s localized nature, it was relatively
## simple to treat. Had I ignored my doctor’s plea and waited to get screened, I could have been
## facing full-blown metastatic disease in just a few years, which is much harder to overcome.

La Donya Reed
Survivor

## How will you help end colorectal cancer?

With your support, we can end colorectal cancer in our lifetime. There are so many ways to take
action!

[Get involved ][155]
[Craig Melvin and Lindsay Czarniak at the National Bash]

### [ Attend an event ][156]

We host events across the U.S. dedicated to raising awareness and funds to combat colorectal cancer.
When you participate in one of our events, you'll help make a meaningful difference in the mission
against this devastating disease.

[man leads runners at the leslie grace 5k]

### [ Start a fundraiser ][157]

End Colon Cancer Coast to Coast empowers you to turn your passion—whether it's golf, running, or any
hobby—into a meaningful fundraiser to help end colorectal cancer. Get the resources you need and
start your fundraiser today!

[Woman at table advocate event]

### [ Become an advocate ][158]

The movement to end colorectal cancer begins with you. We can help you raise your voice. Our Allies
in Action grassroots advocacy program provides the tools and opportunities to make change in your
own community, state, and beyond.

## Donate to end colorectal cancer in our lifetime

Every dollar you give increases access to screening, provides invaluable patient and family
assistance, and helps to fund critical research.

[Donate now][159]

You don't have to do this alone. **Call our helpline: **[**(877) 422-2030**][160]

## They're slow. They're expensive.

They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

## boundaries of innovation

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

Our strategic focus spans the pivotal therapeutic areas of Oncology, Dermatology, and Respiratory.
By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely
positioned to deliver our products reliably, responsibly, and sustainably supporting patients,
healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

### CAUTION NOTICE REGARDING FRAUDULENT RECRUITMENT

×

This is to notify to the public that certain unscrupulous persons, purporting to be part of and/or
being authorised by the human resources department of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited (“Glenmark”)
are fraudulently offering jobs via certain websites/or through telephone calls, SMS or fake letters
and asking the prospective job aspirants to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening
with Glenmark and/or to pay a fee for securing a job with Glenmark. We wish to caution the public
that Glenmark does not collect any monies or any other valuables as a pre or post-employment
requirement.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## **Colon Screening is Serious Business**

# **Prepping Doesn’t Have to Be**

# **Eat While**

# **You Prep**

## **Enjoy Comfort Foods And Flavored Drinks While You Prep**

[Bowls of oatmeal, macaroni & cheese and vegetable bouillon]

### **3 Meals**

Maple Oatmeal • Macaroni & Cheese • Vegetable Bouillon

[Plate of cookies with a bowl of chips]

### **3 Snacks**

Lemon Burst Cookie • BBQ Pop Chips • Chocolate Chip Cookie

[Glass of water with fruit and packaged drink mixes]

### **8 Drink Mixes**

Orange • Lemonade • Berry

[ Learn More ][57]

## **How Can I Use Happy Colon Foods?**

[Speech bubble with a question mark]

### **Ask For Happy Colon Foods**

You have a choice in how to get ready for your colonoscopy. Ask for Happy Colon Foods when you
schedule your colonoscopy.

[Phone and computer cursor]

### **Order Your Kit**

Order online, or call us at (855) 423-6637.

Allow at least 5 business days for your kit to arrive.

[ For Your Doctor ][58]
[Delivery Truck]

### **We Deliver Your Kit**

A package will be delivered to your door.

When it arrives, open it and look through everything. Call us at (855) 423-6637 with any questions.

[Plate with fork and knife]

### **Eat While You Prep**

You’ll enjoy eating real food throughout the day, which will keep you more comfortable as your body
cleanses itself.

Our laxatives are tasteless, too, which means no more gross drinks.

protect public health. Founded in 1904, NABP aims to ensure the public’s health and safety through

as through pharmacy inspection and accreditation programs. For more information, please visit
[*www.nabp.pharmacy*][57].

drugs.”
