Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,

the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

Tablets

coated, chewable and more.

supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

variety of ailments.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

  performed to confirm the presence of colorectal cancer or colorectal polyps from a person showing
  symptoms (blood in stools, anemia, etc.), screening colonoscopy is performed on an asymptomatic
  person without any prior history of the two conditions.
  
  [Learn More][56]

  pipe (esophagus) causing a burning sensation in your chest and other associated symptoms.

* Pancreatitis
  
  The pancreas is a gland that lies behind the stomach. It plays a major role in the digestion of
  food as it produces and releases insulin into the bloodstream to regulate blood sugar levels and
  also secretes digestive enzymes into the small intestine to absorb the remaining food that has
  passed through the stomach.
  
  [Learn More][61]
* Abdominal Pain
  
  Pelvic pain is pain that occurs in the lower abdomen and pelvis. The pelvic region is the area
  between the umbilicus (belly button) and the groin in the front and between the buttocks at the
  back.
  
  [Learn More][62]
* Constipation
  
  Constipation is a condition where stools or bowel movements become hard and difficult to expel
  from the body. This can result in fewer and strained bowel movements. It usually occurs when
  excessive water is absorbed from the stool while inside the colon. Constipation is a common
  condition that affects almost everyone at some time.
  
  [Learn More][63]
* Diarrhea
  
  Diarrhea is loose, watery, frequent bowel movements resulting in the elimination of water and
  salts from the body and can result in dehydration. Diarrhea can be acute or chronic. Acute
  diarrhea lasts for a few days, whereas, chronic diarrhea lasts for many days and is usually
  associated with an intestinal disorder such as inflammatory bowel disease.

* Endoscopy
  
  Upper GI endoscopy is usually performed on an outpatient basis. The endoscope is a long, thin,
  flexible tube with a tiny video camera and light on the end. By adjusting the various controls on
  the endoscope, the endoscopist can safely guide the instrument to carefully examine the inside
  lining of the upper digestive system. Upper GI Endoscopy The high-quality picture from the
  endoscope is shown on a TV monitor; it gives a clear, detailed view. In many cases, upper GI
  endoscopy is a more precise examination than X-ray studies.
  
  [Learn More][65]
* Colon Cancer
  
  Colon cancer is the growth of rapidly dividing cells in the large intestine. Cancer of the colon
  develops from polyps, the small and non-cancerous growths of tissues. Colon cancer usually begins
  in glands lining the colon and rectum. Colon cancer initially begins as a non-cancerous tumor and
  gradually develops into cancer which spreads to other tissues.
  
  [Learn More][66]
* Inflammatory
  Bowel Disease
  
  Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), as the name implies, refers to an inflammatory condition of the
  bowel or gastrointestinal (GI) tract. It is a group of disorders characterized by inflammation of
  the bowel or any part of the GI tract. Though the exact cause of the condition remains unknown,
  the genetic and non-genetic or environmental factors are thought to play a part. All these factors
  may impair the normal functioning of the immune system and the body's defence mechanism attacks
  the body's own tissue causing inflammation of the mucosal lining.
  
  [Learn More][67]
* GERD/Heartburn
  
  Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a condition where the stomach acid leaks into your food
  pipe (esophagus) causing a burning sensation in your chest and other associated symptoms.
  
  Everyone experiences acid reflux once in a while after a heavy meal or when lying down. However,
  people with GERD experience acid reflux on a regular basis, often more than twice a week, and it
  could lead to serious health concerns and negatively impact quality of life.
  
  [Learn More][68]
* Diverticulitis
  
  The intestine is divided into the large and small intestine. The large intestine absorbs nutrients
  from the food that you eat and pushes the remaining undigested waste towards the anus. High
  fibrous foods like fruits and vegetables soften the undigested material and help in easy movement
  of stools. However, low-fiber foods can produce small and hard stools that are expelled with
  increased strain while passing. This straining can create weak spots in the wall of the intestine
  leading to diverticular diseases, conditions that cause the development of small sacs or pouches.
  The conditions include diverticulosis, diverticular bleeding, and diverticulitis.
  
  [Learn More][69]

  alcohol or due to a viral infection. According to the National Institute of Health (NIH), people
  who regularly consume alcohol for more than 10 years can develop cirrhosis.
  
  [Learn More][60]
* Pancreatitis
  
  The pancreas is a gland that lies behind the stomach. It plays a major role in the digestion of
  food as it produces and releases insulin into the bloodstream to regulate blood sugar levels and
  also secretes digestive enzymes into the small intestine to absorb the remaining food that has
  passed through the stomach.
  
  [Learn More][61]
* Abdominal Pain
  
  Pelvic pain is pain that occurs in the lower abdomen and pelvis. The pelvic region is the area
  between the umbilicus (belly button) and the groin in the front and between the buttocks at the
  back.
  
  [Learn More][62]
* Constipation
  
  Constipation is a condition where stools or bowel movements become hard and difficult to expel
  from the body. This can result in fewer and strained bowel movements. It usually occurs when
  excessive water is absorbed from the stool while inside the colon. Constipation is a common
  condition that affects almost everyone at some time.
  
  [Learn More][63]
* Diarrhea
  
  Diarrhea is loose, watery, frequent bowel movements resulting in the elimination of water and
  salts from the body and can result in dehydration. Diarrhea can be acute or chronic. Acute
  diarrhea lasts for a few days, whereas, chronic diarrhea lasts for many days and is usually
  associated with an intestinal disorder such as inflammatory bowel disease.
  
  [Learn More][64]
* Endoscopy
  
  Upper GI endoscopy is usually performed on an outpatient basis. The endoscope is a long, thin,
  flexible tube with a tiny video camera and light on the end. By adjusting the various controls on
  the endoscope, the endoscopist can safely guide the instrument to carefully examine the inside
  lining of the upper digestive system. Upper GI Endoscopy The high-quality picture from the
  endoscope is shown on a TV monitor; it gives a clear, detailed view. In many cases, upper GI
  endoscopy is a more precise examination than X-ray studies.
  
  [Learn More][65]
* Colon Cancer
  
  Colon cancer is the growth of rapidly dividing cells in the large intestine. Cancer of the colon
  develops from polyps, the small and non-cancerous growths of tissues. Colon cancer usually begins
  in glands lining the colon and rectum. Colon cancer initially begins as a non-cancerous tumor and
  gradually develops into cancer which spreads to other tissues.
  
  [Learn More][66]
* Inflammatory
  Bowel Disease
  
  Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), as the name implies, refers to an inflammatory condition of the
  bowel or gastrointestinal (GI) tract. It is a group of disorders characterized by inflammation of
  the bowel or any part of the GI tract. Though the exact cause of the condition remains unknown,
  the genetic and non-genetic or environmental factors are thought to play a part. All these factors
  may impair the normal functioning of the immune system and the body's defence mechanism attacks
  the body's own tissue causing inflammation of the mucosal lining.
  
  [Learn More][67]
* GERD/Heartburn
  
  Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a condition where the stomach acid leaks into your food
  pipe (esophagus) causing a burning sensation in your chest and other associated symptoms.
  
  Everyone experiences acid reflux once in a while after a heavy meal or when lying down. However,
  people with GERD experience acid reflux on a regular basis, often more than twice a week, and it
  could lead to serious health concerns and negatively impact quality of life.
  
  [Learn More][68]
* Diverticulitis
  
  The intestine is divided into the large and small intestine. The large intestine absorbs nutrients
  from the food that you eat and pushes the remaining undigested waste towards the anus. High
  fibrous foods like fruits and vegetables soften the undigested material and help in easy movement
  of stools. However, low-fiber foods can produce small and hard stools that are expelled with
  increased strain while passing. This straining can create weak spots in the wall of the intestine
  leading to diverticular diseases, conditions that cause the development of small sacs or pouches.
  The conditions include diverticulosis, diverticular bleeding, and diverticulitis.
  
  [Learn More][69]

Join IntechOpen in its mission to publish the best scientific research and increase the visibility of your work. [Learn More][61] ### Author in the Centre Built by scientists, for scientists. We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. # Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main

advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using

returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

## Frequently Asked Questions(FAQs)

Can you customize animation styles to align with our brand?

Absolutely! We work closely with each client to ensure that the animation style, color schemes, and
tone align perfectly with their brand identity. Whether you prefer a professional look or a playful,
kid-friendly style, our team can bring your vision to life.

How do you ensure accuracy and cultural sensitivity in translated content?

We employ native speakers and certified linguists to handle translations. Our process includes a
quality assurance review for cultural appropriateness and accuracy, especially for educational
content, where precise terminology is crucial. Additionally, we can integrate region-specific
nuances to enhance relatability.

Do you offer product promotion through animated content?

Yes, we create engaging animated product demos, explainer videos, and promotional materials designed
to showcase your products effectively. Our animations can help highlight product features and
benefits in a way that resonates with your audience and drives conversions.

Can you develop interactive content for e-learning platforms?

Yes! We create interactive videos, quizzes, and scenario-based animations that keep learners
engaged. Our team can work with your LMS or platform to deliver multimedia-rich content that
enhances user engagement and knowledge retention.

How do you handle audio and video production for e-learning courses?

Our audio and video production services cover voiceovers, sound design, background music, and
high-quality video editing. We ensure that all elements are professionally produced and synchronized
with your course materials to create a seamless learning experience.

What is your pricing model for different services?

We offer flexible pricing based on the scope and nature of each service. For instance, animation and
video production costs can vary depending on length, style, and complexity. We provide transparent,
itemized estimates so you understand each cost factor.

Can we review and request changes during the animation production process?

Yes, client feedback is a crucial part of our process. We share drafts and revisions with you at key
milestones, allowing you to request adjustments to ensure the final product meets your expectations.

Do you offer support after the project is delivered?

Yes, we offer post-delivery support to address any minor adjustments or updates you may need. For
ongoing needs, we also offer maintenance packages to keep your content up-to-date and aligned with
your evolving goals.

Can you help us repurpose content for different platforms?

Absolutely! We can adapt your existing content into formats suitable for various platforms, such as
social media, webinars, or mobile apps. This helps maximize your content’s reach and engagement
across diverse audiences.

Do you provide assistance with content strategy and planning?

Yes, we offer content development and strategic planning services to ensure your educational and
promotional content is impactful. Our experts can work with you to identify your goals, target
audience, and key messaging for effective content creation.

How do you ensure high-quality audio and translation for voice overs?

We work with professional voice artists and experienced translators to deliver high-quality
voiceovers in multiple languages. Each recording undergoes a quality check to ensure clarity,
accuracy, and alignment with the tone of your content.

Do you have experience in developing content for specific education sectors or age groups?

Yes, our team has experience creating content for K-12, higher education, and corporate
training**.** We tailor our approach to meet the needs of different age groups, making sure the
content is age-appropriate and pedagogically sound.

itemized estimates so you understand each cost factor.

Can we review and request changes during the animation production process?

Yes, client feedback is a crucial part of our process. We share drafts and revisions with you at key
milestones, allowing you to request adjustments to ensure the final product meets your expectations.

Do you offer support after the project is delivered?

Yes, we offer post-delivery support to address any minor adjustments or updates you may need. For
ongoing needs, we also offer maintenance packages to keep your content up-to-date and aligned with
your evolving goals.

Can you help us repurpose content for different platforms?

Absolutely! We can adapt your existing content into formats suitable for various platforms, such as
social media, webinars, or mobile apps. This helps maximize your content’s reach and engagement
across diverse audiences.

Do you provide assistance with content strategy and planning?

Yes, we offer content development and strategic planning services to ensure your educational and
promotional content is impactful. Our experts can work with you to identify your goals, target
audience, and key messaging for effective content creation.

How do you ensure high-quality audio and translation for voice overs?

We work with professional voice artists and experienced translators to deliver high-quality
voiceovers in multiple languages. Each recording undergoes a quality check to ensure clarity,
accuracy, and alignment with the tone of your content.

Do you have experience in developing content for specific education sectors or age groups?

Yes, our team has experience creating content for K-12, higher education, and corporate
training**.** We tailor our approach to meet the needs of different age groups, making sure the
content is age-appropriate and pedagogically sound.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# Welcome to Raleigh/Cary Medical Group
# Gastroenterology

We are an independent medical practice and a state certified endoscopy facility that provides
comprehensive outpatient and acute in-patient care. Our goal is to provide patients with the latest
in procedures and treatment as they strive to enhance and maintain their quality of life. We utilize
a team approach with professional staff that strives to provide compassionate,
confidential, evidence based and cost-effective care to each individual. Most patients we see are
referred by their primary healthcare provider.

Five primary office locations throughout Wake and Johnston counties allows convenient and timely
patient appointments. Three endoscopy centers (Raleigh, Wake Forest, and one under construction in
Clayton) provides access to cost-effective screenings and other outpatient endoscopic procedures, as
well as office based infusions in three office locations. We currently have nine board certified
gastroenterologists and three physician assistants on staff. Two female gastroenterologists in the
group assures that all gender related gastrointestinal issues are addressed. Our physicians focus on
digestive and liver diseases and perform all routine and advanced procedures including ERCP
(endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography) and EUS (endoscopic ultrasound).

Our facilities are all digital, feature state-of -the-art equipment, and were custom designed for
digestive healthcare. The result for patients is the highest quality care, less wait time, less
paper work, and less expense with Tier 1 recognition by BCBS and Cigna. Our Wake Endoscopy Center is
a North Carolina State certified ambulatory surgery center and is 1 of 15 endoscopy facilities in NC
that are AAAHC approved.

“I had a colonoscopy, my first, and had a very good experience. However, now my son is going to this
practice for a much more critical condition and we could not be happier with the way we have been
treated and how the staff ‘bends over backwards’ to make this difficult experience as good as it can
be. I highly recommend this practice to my friends and family.”

Mark S.
 

“From the time I entered the building at RMG Gastroenterology everyone I encountered was so kind,
compassionate, caring and helpful. From registration, to pre procedure, procedure and post procedure
everyone was EXCELLENT. Highly recommend this practice and cannot say enough positive things about
Dr. Ronald Schwarz and his staff. I was very nervous and they put me at ease. Sincerely thank you!”

Jenny E.
 

“I’m a patient of Dr. Whitt. He and his staff are so amazing, friendly and professional. They make
sure you understand everything about your procedure and are happy to answer any questions you may
have. They take great care of you. I would recommend them for anyone in need of this type of medical
care.”

Patricia L.

# Welcome to Raleigh/Cary Medical Group
# Gastroenterology

We are an independent medical practice and a state certified endoscopy facility that provides
comprehensive outpatient and acute in-patient care. Our goal is to provide patients with the latest
in procedures and treatment as they strive to enhance and maintain their quality of life. We utilize
a team approach with professional staff that strives to provide compassionate,
confidential, evidence based and cost-effective care to each individual. Most patients we see are
referred by their primary healthcare provider.

Five primary office locations throughout Wake and Johnston counties allows convenient and timely
patient appointments. Three endoscopy centers (Raleigh, Wake Forest, and one under construction in
Clayton) provides access to cost-effective screenings and other outpatient endoscopic procedures, as
well as office based infusions in three office locations. We currently have nine board certified
gastroenterologists and three physician assistants on staff. Two female gastroenterologists in the
group assures that all gender related gastrointestinal issues are addressed. Our physicians focus on
digestive and liver diseases and perform all routine and advanced procedures including ERCP
(endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography) and EUS (endoscopic ultrasound).

Our facilities are all digital, feature state-of -the-art equipment, and were custom designed for
digestive healthcare. The result for patients is the highest quality care, less wait time, less
paper work, and less expense with Tier 1 recognition by BCBS and Cigna. Our Wake Endoscopy Center is
a North Carolina State certified ambulatory surgery center and is 1 of 15 endoscopy facilities in NC
that are AAAHC approved.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
*

* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

for paying for all health care services but will be entitled to receive a discount from those health
care providers in accordance with the specific pre-negotiated discounted fee schedule. This program

**Study Design^{1,2}:** This phase 3 trial was conducted in multiple sites. Of the 500 subjects who
enrolled, 450 were evaluable for efficacy analyses. The primary endpoint was the percentage of
subjects with successful cleansing, which was defined as a rating of excellent or good as assigned
by the local endoscopist utilizing the US FDA Bowel Prep Scoring Scale. Independent central readers
also reviewed all colonoscopy videos and provided a global cleansing grade, as well as segmental
grades, on insertion and withdrawal using a 4-point scale of excellent, good, fair, and poor. The
goal of the study was to establish non-inferiority of SUFLAVE to SUPREP Bowel Prep Kit, using a 10%
non-inferiority margin. Most common adverse reactions (≥2%) are: nausea, abdominal distension,
vomiting, abdominal pain and headache.

^{*}Success was defined as an overall cleansing assessment of excellent or good by the blinded
endoscopist; scores were assigned following completion of the colonoscopy;
P<0.001 in this non-inferiority clinical trial.
**IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION**
**SUFLAVE IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION**

**SUFLAVE^{®} (polyethylene glycol 3350, sodium sulfate, potassium chloride, magnesium sulfate, and
sodium chloride for oral solution) **

**Indications and Usage**

SUFLAVE is indicated for the cleansing of the colon as a preparation for colonoscopy in adults.

**ADDITIONAL IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION **

**What is the most important information I should know about SUFLAVE?**

SUFLAVE and other bowel preparations can cause serious side effects, including:
Serious loss of body fluid (dehydration) and changes in body salts (electrolytes) in your blood.
These changes can cause:
* abnormal heartbeats that can cause death.
* seizures. This can happen even if you have never had a seizure.
* kidney problems.

**Do not take SUFLAVE if your healthcare provider has told you that you have:**
* a blockage in your bowel (obstruction) or a problem with food moving too slowly through your
  intestines (ileus).
* an opening in the wall of your stomach or intestine (bowel perforation).
* a very dilated intestine (toxic colitis or toxic megacolon).
* problems with food and fluid emptying from your stomach (gastric retention).
* allergies to any ingredient in SUFLAVE.

**What are the possible side effects of SUFLAVE?**

SUFLAVE can cause serious side effects, including:
* Changes in certain blood tests. Your healthcare provider may do blood tests after you take SUFLAVE
  to check your blood for changes. Tell your healthcare provider if you have any symptoms of too
  much fluid loss, including:
1. vomiting
2. dizziness
3. urinate less than usual
1. nausea
2. stomach (abdominal) cramping
3. trouble drinking clear liquid
1. bloating

[Patient Preference]

**Study Design^{1,2}:** This phase 3 trial was conducted in multiple sites. Of the 500 subjects who
enrolled, 450 were evaluable for efficacy analyses. The primary endpoint was the percentage of
subjects with successful cleansing, which was defined as a rating of excellent or good as assigned
by the local endoscopist utilizing the US FDA Bowel Prep Scoring Scale. Independent central readers
also reviewed all colonoscopy videos and provided a global cleansing grade, as well as segmental
grades, on insertion and withdrawal using a 4-point scale of excellent, good, fair, and poor. The
goal of the study was to establish non-inferiority of SUFLAVE to SUPREP Bowel Prep Kit, using a 10%
non-inferiority margin. Most common adverse reactions (≥2%) are: nausea, abdominal distension,
vomiting, abdominal pain and headache.

^{*}Success was defined as an overall cleansing assessment of excellent or good by the blinded
endoscopist; scores were assigned following completion of the colonoscopy;
P<0.001 in this non-inferiority clinical trial.

**Indications and Usage**

SUFLAVE is indicated for the cleansing of the colon as a preparation for colonoscopy in adults.

**ADDITIONAL IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION **

**What is the most important information I should know about SUFLAVE?**

SUFLAVE and other bowel preparations can cause serious side effects, including:
Serious loss of body fluid (dehydration) and changes in body salts (electrolytes) in your blood.
These changes can cause:
* abnormal heartbeats that can cause death.
* seizures. This can happen even if you have never had a seizure.
* kidney problems.

**Do not take SUFLAVE if your healthcare provider has told you that you have:**
* a blockage in your bowel (obstruction) or a problem with food moving too slowly through your
  intestines (ileus).
* an opening in the wall of your stomach or intestine (bowel perforation).
* a very dilated intestine (toxic colitis or toxic megacolon).
* problems with food and fluid emptying from your stomach (gastric retention).
* allergies to any ingredient in SUFLAVE.

**What are the possible side effects of SUFLAVE?**

SUFLAVE can cause serious side effects, including:
* Changes in certain blood tests. Your healthcare provider may do blood tests after you take SUFLAVE
  to check your blood for changes. Tell your healthcare provider if you have any symptoms of too
  much fluid loss, including:
1. vomiting
2. dizziness
3. urinate less than usual

including if you:**

* have heart problems.

  You and your healthcare provider should decide if you will take SUFLAVE while breastfeeding.

  taking SUFLAVE

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

### Taj Pharmaceuticals Ltd has it's manufacturing facility for the below mention categories of
### pharmaceutical products.

Tablet 22 lac per shift Capsule 22 lac per shift Injection 2.5 lac per shift Dry Injection 3.5 lac
per shift Small Volume Parenterals 4.5 lac per shift Syrups & Suspensions 1.5 lac per shift
Ointments 2.5 lac per shift Dry Syrups 1.5 lac per shift
Manufacturing (Capacity)

[[flask][flask]][123]State-of-the art Liquid Injections (SVP Line) and General Dry Powder
facilities, which adhere to stringent specifications of GMP and WHO-GMP; We are International
standard contract manufacturing Organization.

[[spinner][spinner]][124]Taj Pharma leverages its India units as cost effective manufacturing
together with its extensive expertise and technology platforms to offer competitive, high quality,
custom manufacturing services to a global clientele. Our facility has been inspected by various
international regulators including the USFDA, GMP, WHO & ISO Certified.

[[clock][clock]][125]Taj Pharma’s manufacturing facilities operate to the highest standards of
quality control. Tests produced at all four of our sites are manufactured to stringent levels of
reliability, reproducibility and stability.

> Once again, welcome to [Taj Pharmaceuticals][126], a great company that is translating a great
> vision of generics into reality – We Innovate Generics Healthcare.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.

• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications

## Waitemata Endoscopy provides the highest quality endoscopy with expert staff

[Reduced waiting times.
Your endoscopy booked within 7 days*][45]

## Two Convenient Locations

###### [Wairau Valley, North Shore][46]

At Southern Cross North Harbour campus
212 Wairau Road, Entrance A, Wairau Valley

53 Lincoln Road Henderson

### About Waitemata Endoscopy

[Image]
[Image]

## Our History

#### “Proudly bringing private endoscopy to Aucklanders for almost 20 years”

Waitemata Endoscopy in partnership with Southern Cross Hospitals Limited provide a comprehensive
endoscopy service to patients Auckland wide, from our Northern Clinic on Auckland’s North Shore to
our new clinic at Lincoln Road, Henderson in West Auckland.

### The best doctors, nurses, staff and latest technology

Our multi-disciplinary team approach means that we can better manage the full range of
gastroenterology conditions, including complex and tertiary conditions.

[Gastroscopy]

###### Gastroscopy

Assess for reflux, cancer, ulcers, hernia, coeliac
[Colonoscopy]

##### Colonoscopy

Assess for polyps, cancer, diverticuli, hemorrhoids

[Endoscopic Ultrasound]

##### Endoscopic Ultrasound

Check for gallstones, pancreatic cancer, biopsy nodes/mass

[Minimally Invasive]

##### Minimally Invasive

Advanced in endoscopy result in day-stay treatments instead of surgery

[Image]
[Image]
[Image]
[Image]

### Providing you with the best experience

"Friendly team right from reception to theatre, operating with calm efficiency and respect. "


"I went for a procedure today and suffer from anxiety so wasn't having a great day until I actually
got there and was greeted warmly and professionally. The nurses were caring and took care of me so
well. Met the doctor who was also very caring and allowed me time to explain my issues and concerns.
."


"The procedure itself couldn't have been made more comfortable. The post-procedure care was
excellent and the plunger of coffee and delicious chicken wrap were very welcome after all the prep
and fasting. Top notch service at this clinic. "


### Let us help you improve your digestive system

Auckland's Waitemata Endoscopy offers specialized endoscopy services like gastroscopy, colonoscopy,
and endoscopic ultrasound. See why they're considered the city's top centre of exceptional endoscopy
care.
